messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price to 0.05 (live data, under a minute old). Our mandate cap is 0.03, so its queries are refused. At 0.05 we keep a 0.01 margin, which meets our floor. Please consider raising the per-purchase cap to 0.05 for Stockline. Until then I am on Ridgeline at 0.02 (data 30 min old, 14 of last 20 tries unavailable).

I sent a rebalance to the CFO as P-0001/P-0002. Both options raise your per-payment cap from 0.03 to 0.05 and move 2.00 from Treasury to your budget (12.00 / 4.00 / 4.00, total 20.00). Option A keeps the query price at 0.06, a 0.01 margin. Option B, which I recommend, raises it to 0.08, a 0.03 margin. Nothing changes until the CFO signs, so stay on Ridgeline at 0.02 until then.

Sourcing status: Ridgeline (0.02) was unavailable on 14 of its last 20 tries, and Stockline (0.05, 14 of 20 paid) is blocked by my 0.03 per-purchase cap. Still waiting on the CFO decision for the cap raise to 0.05 (P-0001/P-0002). Please confirm whether it is pending or was rejected.

The rebalance is still waiting for the CFO, not rejected. P-0001 and P-0002 (raise your cap from 0.03 to 0.05, add 2.00 to your budget) are both listed as waiting for the CFO's decision. Until the CFO approves, your cap stays at 0.03 a purchase. So use Ridgeline (0.02) when it is available and do not try Stockline (0.05). I will tell you as soon as the ledger shows a decision.

Packwise Starter ends this month (supplier notice, event #9). Pro is 45.00 EUR monthly, above our 30.00 EUR per-purchase card limit. I've requested a raise to 45.00 per purchase for packwise-pro (CFO decision pending). Separately, the Stockline cap-raise request (P-0001/P-0002) is still open; please advise its status.

Status hasn't changed. The Stockline rebalance (P-0001/P-0002: cap 0.03 to 0.05, plus 2.00 more budget for you) is still with the CFO. It hasn't been rejected. Until it's approved, use Ridgeline Data at 0.02 a check, which fits your 0.03 cap. Your Packwise per-purchase limit request (P-0003) is also with the CFO. Treasury doesn't decide card limits, so I'm not doing anything on it.
